scope: Read-only audit of existing catalog attributes and facets. No web research, new products or site edits.

chiller.currentEvidence: All 12 current cold plunges include a chiller. No current record supports optional-chiller or ice-only. Render only populated values; a one-option control should not take prominent filter space.
chiller.unknownRule: Missing positive inclusion evidence stays unclassified, never automatically tub-only or ice-only.
chiller.configurationRule: Continue using setup=integrated/inflatable/portable-rigid to explain the equipment arrangement.

power.rule: Add a derived UI group; preserve existing power leaf values and full Power requirements. Primary US setup determines group. Universal-input compatibility can be shown separately.
power.warning: Battery/no-AC group contains rechargeable devices needing chargers and self-powered/battery-console equipment; do not label every member no electricity required.

recommendation.capacity: Use people capacity only where explicitly documented. Gym user weight, stack resistance and structural load stay separate. Most gym/panel capacity omissions are not errors.
recommendation.footprint: Calculated equipment area excludes operating space. All separate-chiller plunge calculations must say tub only. Missing stand/cradle dimensions or conflicting dimensions remain unknown.
recommendation.warranty: Use a clearly named minimum included equipment coverage field; do not promote longest frame coverage, optional extensions or membership-linked coverage as a whole-product minimum.

power.rule: Use the full requirement text. Wattage alone cannot establish voltage, plug type or circuit.

chillerIncluded.rule: Positive inclusion in the selected priced configuration is required. Integrated chiller counts as included. An optional accessory elsewhere on a page is not inclusion.

capacity.rule: Occupancy only for the people-capacity facet. Do not convert gallons, user height or weight limits into an occupancy count.

userWeight.rule: Only display a body-weight limit explicitly labeled for the user; retain height and fit qualifications.

loadCapacity.rule: Keep equipment load limits distinct from user weight and included weight-stack resistance.

dimensions.rule: Keep axis order and upright/reclined context. Do not mix internal depth with external height.

footprint.rule: Prefer existing qualified calculation. Fall back to Dimensions only for a defensible horizontal bounding rectangle; label partial-equipment footprint.

storage.rule: Storage size is separate from operating footprint.

clearance.rule: Display explicit setup/door/wall conflicts; do not silently choose the smaller figure.

warranty.rule: Base included coverage only; preserve parts/labor/consumable differences. Paid or membership-conditional extensions do not raise the base facet.

placement.rule: Retain covered-outdoor, dry-area and freeze restrictions.

setup.rule: Keep installation, circuit and assembly requirements visible.

temperature.rule: Minimum-cooling facet applies to cold plunges only. A sauna maximum is not a cooling minimum.

heatType.rule: Keep cooling-only versus heating-capable configurations distinct.

included.rule: Show exclusions alongside inclusions, especially pictured stands, cords and accessories.

priceBasis.rule: Preserve exact model/variant and mandatory extras.

ongoingCosts.rule: Support both singular and plural keys; disclose required subscription price and renewal separately.

availability.rule: Orderable does not mean in stock; preserve preorder and lead-time text.

returns.rule: Keep restocking and freight deductions, not just the window.

battery.rule: Retain estimated runtime and source conflicts.

ledCount.rule: Do not conflate LED packages and chips.

equipmentWeight.rule: Equipment weight is not a load capacity.
